_about: Query recipes for `python3 studio/rag.py context <role> <step>`. Each step lists queries; {topic} comes from --topic or the film's 00-brief.md, {format} from --format. kind/tier/scope filter the studio index; film:true queries read only the film's own index (projects/<slug>/.rag/film.db). Owner rules (Global + the role's LEARNINGS.md sections) and the pinned never-bend rules are always added in full, outside the budget. Roles match studio/caveman.py ROLES.
